full_transcript_playback.text: Hey, Magic Mike here from Ride Electric. I can help you with workshop updates, bookings, repairs and product questions. So, What are you after today?
[Patient] Okay, I'm here to help with anything else you need. Could you please let me know what you're looking for?
Uh, will you buy back an electric bike and warranty?

[Patient] We don’t offer a buy-back program for electric bikes or warranties. If you're looking to sell your bike, we recommend checking with local marketplaces or second-hand platforms. Let me know if you need help with anything else.

[Patient] Your warranty covers repairs and parts for defects in materials or workmanship, as outlined in your warranty terms. If you're having an issue, I can help you check the status or guide you on next steps. Could you please share your bike’s serial number or job reference?

[Patient] The serial number is usually found imprinted on the handlebar stem of your bike. It’s a good idea to keep it handy for warranty registration or service inquiries. Let me know if you need help with anything else.
I’ll see if I can find it and call back.
[Enthusiastically] No problem at all! Take your time, and feel free to call back whenever you're ready. Have a great day...
